I implemented `convert()` in `src/billing/currency.py`. I haven't run it or added tests.

It multiplies the amount in cents by the `Decimal` rate and rounds toward negative infinity (`ROUND_FLOOR`). That follows the April 2026 Treasury decision on conversion rounding, so a conversion never credits more than the rate allows. It takes and returns integer cents with no floats, per the money convention.

The edit hook flagged the "Invoice PDF rendering" memory as possibly invalidated. This change doesn't touch PDF rendering, so I think the warning is spurious and I left that memory alone.
